technology.summary:
Today's most important technology news includes Microsoft's announcement that it will allow Microsoft 365 Family and Premium subscribers to share AI benefits, including Copilot and AI usage features, alongside access to Office apps and OneDrive storage. This follows the debut of new AI-friendly hardware and Windows changes at a Microsoft event.

In other news, India has rejected Elon Musk's claim of discrimination over the Starlink launch, while Uber and China's Pony.ai plan to launch robotaxis in London.

Vesta, an AI-native software startup, has raised $30 million to bring swarms of agents to mortgage lenders, and China's Manus has raised over $500 million in its first funding round since splitting with Meta.

Finally, GTA VI leaks continue with a lengthy (and very nude) gameplay video.

finance.summary: Today's most important finance news includes a decline in Indian equity benchmarks due to profit booking and rising oil prices, with the Nifty 50 index closing down by 95.75 points. The Securities and Exchange Board of India and the Reserve Bank of India have joined forces to streamline regulatory procedures and facilitate foreign portfolio investors' entry into the market. A resurgent El Niño pattern may exacerbate the selloff in Southeast Asian bonds, pushing yields higher amid rising US Treasury rates and oil prices. The Supreme Court of India's landmark ruling on hospital markups for cancer drugs resulted in a 5% drop in the BSE Hospitals Index, impacting major players like Apollo Hospitals and Fortis Healthcare.

politics.summary:
The Delhi High Court has dismissed pleas for a SIT probe into the 2020 riots and 2019 Jamia violence. Meanwhile, the Supreme Court will list a plea to allow peaceful protests to Jantar Mantar. Protesters are demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

In other news, Donald Trump has cited a non-existent Indian election to call the US electoral process 'corrupt'. Jairam Ramesh has attacked the CEC, claiming his ability to execute G2's illegal orders makes him a liability for the country.

India's foreign exchange reserves have reportedly dropped by $18.34 billion in a single week.

Bengali actor Koel Mallick has joined the BJP.
